noise_policy: Never force noise (-1) into clusters; evaluated via exclude_noise_label=-1.

selection_summary.criterion: Hard gates: valid_for_internal_metrics=True, 3<=n_clusters<=10, min_cluster_share>=0.03, 0<noise_ratio<=0.25; ranked by equal-weight normalized composite of Silhouette(+), DBI(-), CHI(+), spatial_coherence_lift(+), and spatial_fold_mean_ari(+).
